implementation_authors.scope: trusted_gate.py, github_s00.py, plan-gates.yml, ci-policy.json, test_trusted_gate.py, S00_RUNBOOK.md, governance.json

review_scope.method: Read-only independent source and regression-test review; all nine reviewed files verified byte-for-byte against the reviewed commit.
review_scope.baseline_guard: Earlier planctl.py implementation by this reviewer is excluded from this independent review; root reviewed that guard separately.
review_scope.third_party_actions: Pinned action origins were checked; this is not a full audit of third-party action implementations.
review_scope.code_decision: No remaining concrete code findings within the agreed S00 preparation scope.

resolved_findings.finding: An older workflow checkout could validate a PR whose trusted base had advanced.
resolved_findings.resolution: assert_trusted_revision requires the trusted checkout to equal the current PR base; stale events fail closed.

resolved_findings.finding: A superseded run could publish a result for a newer untested PR head.
resolved_findings.resolution: The real inline publisher performs no status write when the current head differs from the tested head.

resolved_findings.finding: A retarget to another branch with an equal base SHA was not fully bound to the checked target.
resolved_findings.resolution: Head, base SHA, base ref and repository ID are bound between validation and publication.

resolved_findings.finding: Reviewer exclusion did not account for all attributed implementation accounts.
resolved_findings.resolution: All PR commits are enumerated with pagination; attributed authors and committers, PR author and observed synchronize sender are excluded. Incomplete or unattributed history fails closed.

resolved_findings.finding: A synchronize event with a missing or null sender was treated like an event without an observed push.
resolved_findings.resolution: synchronize_sender requires a dictionary with a positive integer account ID. A targeted regression covers missing/null, empty, Boolean, zero and string identities and a valid identity.

resolved_findings.finding: Test subprocesses could inherit additional Actions tokens.
resolved_findings.resolution: Child environments use a small allowlist; GitHub, Actions and custom token variables, Git configuration injection variables and PYTHONPATH are removed.

resolved_findings.finding: An early failure could leave an inaccurate state_mutated assertion.
resolved_findings.resolution: The finally path compares actual state bytes; modification or removal reports state_mutated=true and forces failure.

resolved_findings.finding: Failure to write GITHUB_OUTPUT could leave a successful JSON result.
resolved_findings.resolution: The exception path sets status=failed and returns failure; the regression executes the actual adapter with an unavailable output parent.

additional_review_observations: Collector operates on real Git objects and explicit worktree revisions; both rename paths, copies, deletions, mode changes, ignored/untracked paths and gitlinks are represented.
Collector refuses unsupported content filters, sparse or assume-unchanged indexes, partial/promisor repositories and legacy grafts; implicit transports are disabled.
Candidate PR code is not checked out or executed by the prepared trusted CI path.
The entire nested canonical masterplan is immutable, and trusted runtime self-replacement is rejected.
Runbook and governance evidence distinguish local preparation, installed trusted CI, external review identity and protected step completion.
The prepared workflow does not invoke finish.

test_evidence.source: Root reported the completed final aggregate run and its logs.
test_evidence.scope: Local tests only; fixtures are not real GitHub CI or platform reviewer evidence.

open_completion_blockers.requirement: Bind the actual ExtremeLab repository and independently install the reviewed bootstrap into its trusted default branch.
open_completion_blockers.missing_evidence: Actual repository binding and installed trusted bootstrap revision.

open_completion_blockers.requirement: Establish and verify a genuinely separate configured platform reviewer identity for the exact candidate commit.
open_completion_blockers.missing_evidence: Real platform identity and review evidence; local fixture identities and agent identities are insufficient.

open_completion_blockers.requirement: Run real positive and negative CI exercises using the installed trusted verifier.
open_completion_blockers.missing_evidence: Platform runs with exact repository, base and head bindings.

open_completion_blockers.requirement: Verify repository rules, trusted status source, stale-review handling, last-push approval and protection against direct self-approval of progress.
open_completion_blockers.missing_evidence: Actual branch/ruleset configuration and effective enforcement evidence.

open_completion_blockers.requirement: Install and independently review the protected progress writer with real CI/review evidence, exact revisions and cross-runner serialization using regular verify and finish commands.
open_completion_blockers.missing_evidence: Protected completion path and its enforcement evidence.

gate_interpretation: S00-C03 permits an explicitly blocked branch-protection state to be documented. It does not waive the required trustworthy CI/diff source, separated review or protected progress path.

reported_controller_state.source: Root confirmation after the final aggregate test run.
